accepted_claims: Selected one Ethernet-private clock-manager write/restore target: CLK_ETH_CTRL for RP1_CLK_ETH / tx_clk.
Selected Talos register address is observed-aperture CPU physical 0x1c00018064, derived from observed RP1 base 0x1c00000000 plus clock-manager offset 0x018000 and CLK_ETH_CTRL offset 0x00064.
Allowed future operation is pre-read, idempotent write of pre_raw, post-read, restore-write of pre_raw, and restore-read of the 32-bit little-endian control register.
The future proof must preserve the full 32-bit raw value, CLK_CTRL_ENABLE bit 11, CLK_CTRL_AUXSRC bits 9:5, source bits, and reserved bits.
Paired control must use the same report path while constructing no writable RP1 clock-manager target and performing no volatile load/store to RP1 clock/reset or downstream paths.
The target is materially different from the accepted CLK_ETH_TSU_CTRL proof because it selects RP1_CLK_ETH / tx_clk rather than RP1_CLK_ETH_TSU / tsu_clk.
retained_risks: The target proves only one Ethernet-private tx clock-manager store/readback boundary, not broad Ethernet clock ownership.
The selected address depends on the accepted observed 0x1c RP1 aperture and still needs serialized hardware proof with identity, TFTP, serial freshness, final identity, and restore evidence.
Non-idempotent CLK_ETH_CTRL field transitions remain unaccepted.
PHY reset remains GPIO32/MDIO-owned and separate from this clock/reset task.
